title: The Comparative Trap: Pairwise Comparisons Amplifies Biased Preferences of LLM Evaluators

bias_targets.target: Superficial attribute bias (e.g., verbosity, authoritative tone)
bias_targets.methodology: Using adversarial meta-evaluation datasets (e.g., LLMBar-Adversarial) containing pairs of responses where one follows instructions and the other is adversarially crafted to have high superficial quality (e.g., verbose or authoritative tone) but fails to follow instructions, to measure how often LLM evaluators favor the superficial attributes.
